description:
This week on UnF*ck My Startup, Adam Robinson and Pete Crowley welcome Taylor Haren, the mastermind behind sending millions of emails a month for companies like Fixer and RB2B! 

If you're wondering how to scale your cold email outreach, navigate the ever-changing spam filters, and get real results, this episode is for you.


Inside this episode:

-Infrastructure for Scale: Learn how to send 5,000 emails a day (and plan for 15,000) using 250 email accounts across 125 domains, and what happens when you push to 8.5 million emails a month. 

-The Truth About Warmup: Discover why "warmup" is more about diluting your complaint pool than mimicking human activity, and the surprising results of A/B tests on new domains. 

-Finding Your Leads: Taylor reveals his multi-vendor approach to building massive and effective prospect lists, including Apollo, Bounceband, Lead Magic, and Wizza. 

-Cracking the Copy Code: Understand why "copy is king" and how even subtle changes (like "AI" vs. "ai") can drastically affect deliverability and reply rates. 

-Beyond the Sequence: Challenge traditional notions of multi-touchpoint sequences and learn why a single, highly relevant email can be more effective. 

-Get ready to unf*ck your cold email strategy and scale your outreach like never before!
